employee.description: The id or name of the employee that spent the time.

project.description:
The id or full name of the project on which the time was spent on.
Note that the full name includes the name(s) of any parent project(s) separated by colons.

customer.description: The id or name of the customer for whom the time was spent on.

classification.description: The id or name of the classification.

billable.description: Whether the time can be billed to a customer.

item.description:
The id or full name of the item that the time entry relates to.
Note that the full name includes the name(s) of any parent item(s) separated by colons.

payrollItem.description: The id or full name of the payroll pay item that the time entry relates to.

anyOf.description: Time details for a time entry being created or updated.

startTime.description: The start time. Required if duration is not specified.

endTime.description: The end time. Required if duration is not specified.

duration.description: The duration in minutes. Used if specified, otherwise calculated from startTime and endTime.

notes.description: Notes related to the time entry.

declineReason.description:
Reason why time entry approval was declined.
Note that this cannot be set via POST.
